subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go/minimax-m3 thinking content leaks to channel via Anthropic Messages path

question: Should OpenClaw authorize a narrow opencode-go/minimax-m3 reasoning-disclosure fix, and should the accepted mitigation force disabled thinking or wait for a sanitizer shape proven against live proxy output?
rationale: This is a security-sensitive reasoning disclosure path, and the previous candidate PR showed that the mitigation changes provider semantics and needs live channel/provider proof.

options.title: Require live proof, then fix
options.body: Ask for redacted live opencode-go/minimax-m3 proof and then accept the smallest provider-local payload or sanitizer fix that preserves final output.

options.title: Sponsor disabled thinking
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept forcing disabled thinking for this proxy model if they also require regression coverage and upgrade notes.

options.title: Pause until reproducible
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation until a maintainer or reporter provides a live transcript or log proving the current proxy behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live proof, then fix
